name: Loading
description: Spinner for the React Native mobile app — a parametric SVG ring (grey track + gradient arc) with an optional centered Statrys mark, sizes 2xs–lg.
notes: Requires react-native-svg (already a peer dependency). Ring rotation uses RN's Animated (no new dependency), disabled via AccessibilityInfo's reduceMotion, matching the web component's prefers-reduced-motion behavior.
